name: Allie Howe
bio: Allie Howe is an AI security engineer and Member of Technical Staff at Keycard, which she joined in June 2026. She is the co-creator and host of the Insecure Agents podcast, launched with Kyle Bhiro in early 2025. She is a workstream lead for the OWASP Agentic Security Initiative, where she helped organize an agent-security hackathon and co-created FinBot, a financial-services capture-the-flag app. She is also the founder of Growth Cyber, where she worked as a virtual CISO advising AI startups on security and compliance. She started in software development before moving to security engineering and holds a master's in cybersecurity. Her work focuses on agent identity, authorization, runtime controls, and accountability.
